theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_sf_cutoff_gradient
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (a b : ℝ), a < b → Continuous f → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[N].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M x (approxTangentPlane N M x) ∧ G x ∈ approxTangentPlane N M x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[N] (M ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |f y - f x - inner ℝ (G x) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ N)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[N].restrict M), f x = a → G x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[N].restrict M), f x = b → G x = 0) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[N].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M x (approxTangentPlane N M x) ∧ (if a < f x ∧ f x < b then -(b - a)⁻¹ • G x else 0) ∈ approxTangentPlane N M x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[N] (M ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |min 1 (max 0 ((b - f y) / (b - a))) - min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) - inner ℝ (if a < f x ∧ f x < b then -(b - a)⁻¹ • G x else 0) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ N)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
